meta.name: Money Trap
meta.description: When a mythical map falls into the hands of a legendary scam artist, he decides to pull one last con before leaving it all behind for good.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Asım and his gang get their hands on a mysterious map believed to lead to a Karun treasure — but is the relic real or just an old piece of leather?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Still unsure about the validity of the map, Asım decides to recruit the expertise of Sado — the chaotic leader of the rule-breaking Gebeş family.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The chase for a prized bird begins, when Asım's best chance at some quick cash takes flight. Nefise Balamar and Asım strike a deal for the coveted map.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Saruhan traps Asım in a water tank as punishment, but Sampiyon makes a well-timed appearance. A kidnapped cryptologist reveals the myth behind the map.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Asım's delicate state encourages Nazlı to finally make amends with her father. Nefise finds out that having a copy of the map is of no use to her.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Saruhan and Asım come face to face again as negotiations for the map get underway, but when Nazlı is kidnapped the stakes are suddenly much higher.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: A riddle is decoded and suddenly the map is seen through a new light. While the gang celebrates Nazlı is unable to see eye to eye with her father's ambitions.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: An unlikely allyship forms as Asım and Saruhan outrun their rivals and follow the map's clues across Istanbul, in search of the Karun treasure.
